title: More room to edit images, longer Nova Reel clips
summary:
More reference images for Klein edits, cached repeat audio, and fixes for video, transcription, and API keys.

FLUX.2 Klein 4B image editing now accepts up to 10 reference images instead of 4, alongside a backend change for generation and editing. Nova Reel’s multi-shot request fix lets its model accept durations up to 60 seconds in six-second steps; Enter’s query validator still caps requests at 30 seconds.

GET audio requests with the same text and generation parameters can return a cached response; `seed=-1` requests fresh output. A community contribution also requests word-level timestamps for OVHcloud Whisper transcriptions, including detailed responses such as `verbose_json`.

Key verification now reads updated permissions and metadata directly, including permission grants for device-flow keys. The authorization screen also has a clearer label for the `keys` scope.

daily.title: More references for Klein edits
daily.text: Edit with `FLUX.2 Klein 4B` using up to 10 reference images, up from 4. [Find the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=FLUX.2%20Klein%204B).

daily.title: Repeat audio, less waiting
daily.text: Repeated GET audio requests with the same text and generation parameters can return a cached response. Use `seed=-1` when you want a fresh generation. [Explore the audio API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
